interpretation.text_changes: Exact decoded-text inequality to same-batch baseline; not behavioral success.
interpretation.weak_flags: Stored quality, lexical, format and marker screens; not semantic labels or confirmed discoveries.
interpretation.token_caps: Cap-ended continuations are censored; full saved token lists do not imply a finished answer.
interpretation.coverage: Only intact summary-hashed committed chunks with complete 16-way rows and same-batch joins; duplicate neurons excluded. Partials never contribute.
interpretation.native_overdrive: Signed/absolute amplitude divided by observed calibration absolute maximum only; not a natural-population range.
interpretation.provenance_limit: Archive receipts checked against local frozen sources. Checkpoint weights, tokenizer execution and decoded text are not independently reproduced.
interpretation.norm_matching: Recorded nominal L2 norms only; realized BF16 perturbations were not measured.
